trigger: Creator rejected the repeated cafe/doorway visual system and asked to invoke Layer C for a different route.
locked_copy: Keep the supplied 8-slide Capricorn man / Aries woman copy, but rebuild the visual story from zero.
hard_rejections: doorway plus balcony repeated as the whole story
poster crop with one person cut out
quote-card composition where the text does all the work

Storyline Architect.route: Turn the deck into one continuous evening route through the city: he brings the plan, she discovers the night.
Storyline Architect.protect: A real story arc: preparation -> detour -> worry -> care -> instinct -> delight -> belonging.

Contrarian Critic.risk: Capricorn/Aries can become generic 'planner vs chaos' content. It needs a specific cinematic container.
Contrarian Critic.repair: Make the plan a physical route map and make her spark change the route through visible city moments.

Retention Analyst.hook: Slide 1 must show the entire premise immediately: he has a route, she is already pointing somewhere else.
Retention Analyst.swipe_ladder: Each slide should reveal one more detour, not repeat the same couple pose.

Visual Director.winner: The Route He Planned, The City She Found
Visual Director.why: It creates varied frames: balcony map, auto stand, ticket window, street map, rain shelter, crossing, alley lights, night market, quiet rooftop.

Copy Chief.copy_status: Use creator copy exactly. No extra public words.
Copy Chief.text_rule: Text sits in designed negative spaces: sky, wall, awning, route-map blank area, rain-shadow, rooftop sky.

Final Selector.reason: This route makes the same copy feel like a cinematic mini-film instead of a zodiac quote carousel.

route_candidates.name: The Route He Planned, The City She Found
route_candidates.summary: One continuous evening walk/ride through the city. His planned route keeps appearing; her instinct keeps opening better scenes. No cafe-table staging.
route_candidates.why_it_wins: It gives the carousel movement, visual variety, and a specific story container without needing private context.

route_candidates.name: Two Weather Systems
route_candidates.summary: He is calm blue-grey weather; she is red spark/wind. Visually poetic but risks becoming too metaphorical and less specific.

route_candidates.name: One Table, Eight Interruptions
route_candidates.summary: Cafe/table setup. Rejected because it already produced repeated frames and weak storyboard progression.

route_candidates.name: Astrology Editorial Portraits
route_candidates.summary: Pretty Capricorn/Aries portraits. Rejected as generic zodiac content.

route_candidates.name: The Notebook Becomes A Love Map
route_candidates.summary: A notebook transforms across slides. Strong object motif, but could become prop-first if not grounded in scenes.

selected_route.name: The Route He Planned, The City She Found
selected_route.logline: He planned the evening like a route. She turned the route into a story.
selected_route.visual_thesis: Capricorn is not dull structure; he is the map that lets her run. Aries is not random chaos; she is the spark that makes the map worth following.
selected_route.style: premium romantic Indian city-evening slice-of-life watercolor-and-ink, cinematic but not poster-like
selected_route.text_strategy: Exact text remains on-image. Text is composed into each frame from the beginning, not removed and not slapped on afterward.
